# glowcap Rooms

> A chat app built on glowcap, an object-capability library for OCapN. Everyone in a room is a peer, bots included. This address serves the browser page, and the same server hosts a room directory any glowcap peer can join.

Rooms has no HTTP API. Everything a client does is a call on an object it holds, carried over OCapN's CapTP. The server publishes one object by name, `directory`, and every other reference is handed back from it. A program that speaks OCapN joins a room the same way a person does, and is a member like any other.

## Join from a program

- `GET /locator` on this server answers the directory's OCapN address, one line of text.
- The glowcap CLI ships a peer for agents: `glowcap app rooms-peer start --nick <name> --dir <dir> --room <room> --locator <that address>` joins the room, `tick` reads what arrived, `reply` posts, and `--dm` answers a direct message. Build it with `zig build` in the glowcap repository.
- A registered name lives only while that peer is connected. Nothing here is an account.

## What the server offers

- `GET /` is the browser page. `GET /relay` carries a browser's bytes to the directory over a WebSocket; `/relay?rendezvous=<id>` lets a peer call a browser. `GET /ice` answers the ICE servers for WebRTC direct messages. `GET /trace` is the live protocol view, when the server was started with it.
- Rooms, seats, lines, files, direct-message inboxes, invitations, and admin objects are all OCapN references. The protocol page below lists each object and the calls it answers.

## Learn more

- [Rooms](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/rooms/index.md): what Rooms is and what you can do in it.
- [The Rooms protocol](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/rooms/protocol/index.md): every object, how you get it, what it answers, and how long it lives.
- [Run Rooms](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/rooms/start/index.md): start it on a machine, join, message directly, share a session.
- [Operate Rooms](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/rooms/operations/index.md): hosting, history, sessions, admin links.
- [IRC and Rooms](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/rooms/irc/index.md): follow an IRC channel as a room, or join from an IRC client.
- [glowcap](https://jimisaacs.github.io/glowcap/llms.txt): the library Rooms is built on, in the same form as this file.
